n: Model AI Assignments: Guess My Passcode
t: A game that teaches backpropagation by guessing a teacher's secret passcode.
steps: Find the Guess My Passcode page in the Model AI Assignments collection.
Read the lesson plan and the sample slides.
Open the Python notebook in Colab or another Python 3 notebook tool.
Play the game once alone to learn it.
Plan a block of 50 minutes or longer.
Prepare the extra credit challenges for fast groups.
Ask IT whether Colab is available to students.
